priorityList: Cast Felblade with Inertia ready (if unavailable, use Fel Rush instead)
Cast The Hunt
Cast Death Sweep
Cast Immolation Aura if at 2 charges (requires A Fire Inside talent)
Cast Vengeful Retreat to trigger Initiative, aligning with Eye Beam
Cast Eye Beam or Abyssal Gaze (ensure any Annihilation and Death Sweep procs of Demonsurge are consumed first)
Cast Essence Break while in Metamorphosis, filling the 4-second window with Death Sweep and Annihilation casts
Cast Metamorphosis with Eye Beam and Death Sweep on cooldown
Cast Blade Dance
Cast Annihilation or Chaos Strike
Cast Immolation Aura or Consuming Fire
Cast Felblade
Cast Throw Glaive or Fel Rush if no other abilities are available and you are waiting on Fury
Cast Metamorphosis on cooldown, or when the boss encounter requires high burst damage.
Cast The Hunt on cooldown.
Cast Eye Beam on cooldown to trigger the Fel-Scarred Inner Demon and Demonic buffs.
Cast Death Sweep (or Blade Dance) on cooldown.
Cast Essence Break (if talented) immediately following an Eye Beam.
Cast Annihilation (or Chaos Strike) as your primary Fury spender, prioritizing windows where Essence Break or Metamorphosis are active.
Cast Sigil of Flame on cooldown to generate Fury and maintain periodic damage.
Cast Immolation Aura on cooldown to generate Fury.
Cast Felblade to generate Fury or to close the gap to your target.
Cast Demon's Bite if you have no other Fury generation abilities available and are below your spender threshold.
